KB.Article.Stations.Title: Favorites, Edit Mode, Import & Global Search
KB.Article.Stations.Summary: KINK channels out of the box, 40,000+ Radio Browser streams, Radi-oh! backup import, and bulk management.
KB.Article.Stations.Body:
Dial launches with four preconfigured KINK channels (KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's). Use the Discover tab to search 40,000+ worldwide streams by name, genre, or country with instant preview playback.

In Settings → Radio you can switch between the compact Radi-oh!-inspired list view and 2×2 station cards, including position numbers (01., 02.), alignment, and font scale.

Click the pencil icon next to Favorites to enter Edit mode (with a sticky toolbar on long lists):
• Add custom stream URLs manually or rename existing stations.
• Select multiple stations via checkboxes or Shift+click range selection for bulk delete and multi-select drag-and-drop reordering.
• Export and import favorites via .chassispack files, share codes, or Radi-oh! JSON backups (preserving customName and sorting order).
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Title: Stream Buffer, Frame Playout & Track Info
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Summary: Frame-accurate MediaStreamSource queue on a single connection with configurable 2s–30s read-ahead buffering.
KB.Article.StreamBuffer.Body:
To prevent audio crackles, stutters, and silent dropouts, Dial uses a dedicated frame-accurate MediaStreamSource engine for MP3 and AAC/HE-AAC streams.

• Single clean connection: Inline ICY metadata (StreamTitle) is extracted directly from the audio connection without opening a second stream socket.
• True duration buffering: Choose how many seconds Dial buffers ahead in Settings → Radio (2s, 5s default, 10s, 15s, or 30s). Live queue depth is displayed in the player header (Buffer X.X/Ys).
• Seamless recovery: On transient drops the engine reconnects cleanly on a frame sync boundary and applies rebuffer hysteresis before resuming playout.
• Fallback paths: Non-MP3/AAC formats (Ogg, Opus, FLAC) route through a local loopback buffer proxy, while HLS/playlists (.m3u8, .pls) pass straight to direct playback.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Title: Mini-Player, VU Meter, Sleep Timer & Statistics
KB.Article.TimerMini.Summary: Compact mini-player (Ctrl+M) with stereo L/R VU meter, up to 6-hour sleep timer, and per-station stats.
KB.Article.TimerMini.Body:
Press Ctrl+M or click the mini-player icon to switch to a compact window featuring an Always-on-Top pin, full transport and volume controls, and a smooth 60fps WASAPI stereo L/R VU meter.

Use the clock button to schedule an automatic stop up to 6 hours ahead (also cancellable from the tray menu). Open the statistics popover to inspect session duration and total listening time per station—backed by an idle-free timer that only ticks during active playback.
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Title: Customizable Global Hotkeys & Media Keys
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Summary: Personalize all five global shortcuts in Settings → Radio alongside Windows SMTC media keys.
KB.Article.Hotkeys.Body:
Hardware media keys and Windows SMTC integration (lock screen & OS volume overlay) work automatically at all times.

Enable 'Global hotkeys' in Settings → Radio to control Dial from any application. All five actions (Play/Stop, Next station, Previous station, Mute/Unmute, and Show/Hide window) are fully customizable:
• Combine Ctrl, Alt, and/or Shift with any letter (A–Z), digit (0–9), or Space.
• Click the record button to press a shortcut directly on your keyboard (Esc cancels).
• Duplicate combinations or shortcuts claimed by another app are flagged immediately, and 'Reset defaults' restores all defaults in one click.
KB.Article.Tray.Title: Background Playback & System Tray
KB.Article.Tray.Summary: Minimize or close cleanly to the system tray with low memory footprint while audio keeps playing.
KB.Article.Tray.Body:
Under Settings → System Tray & Background, configure whether closing or minimizing hides Dial to the Windows notification area, and whether to start minimized. When collapsed, Dial clears its visual XAML tree and runs GC.Collect(1) while playback continues seamlessly.

Right-click the tray icon to switch among favorite stations, pause/resume, mute, or cancel an active sleep timer.
KB.Article.Storage.Title: Isolated Storage, Themes & Single-Instance
KB.Article.Storage.Summary: Atomic storage in %AppData%\Dial, Fluent 2 Mica Alt theming, and single-instance activation redirect.
KB.Article.Storage.Body:
Preferences (config\settings.json), favorites (data\stations.json), listening statistics (data\listening_stats.json), and crash logs (logs\) are stored atomically in %AppData%\Dial\.

In Settings you can switch themes (System / Light / Dark), follow the Windows accent color or select a custom swatch/picker color, and toggle between English and Dutch. Launching Dial a second time automatically brings the active window back into focus.
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedTitleBarCatchph: Added a rotating startup catchphrase beside the app title and live station/track status beside the version badge in the titlebar.
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedTrackLookup: Added quick track lookup from the player and mini-player, configurable in Settings → Radio (toggleable with support for Spotify, YouTube Music, Deezer, and Tidal).
Changelog.v011Alpha.AddedDiscoverMinBitr: Added minimum audio quality (bitrate) filtering in Discover (all qualities or 64+ to 320 kbps) with persisted preference and server/client enforcement.
Changelog.v011Alpha.ChangedPerformanceAn: Made the volume slider snappy (1% steps, debounced settings save, fast UI path) and reduced CPU/allocation footprint via cached theme brushes, decoupled buffer telemetry, deduplicated tray menu rebuilds, and idle-pausing VU meter.
Changelog.v011Alpha.ChangedFeedbackWip: Marked the titlebar feedback button as greyed-out work-in-progress with a hover notice for upcoming GitHub issue integration.
Changelog.v011Alpha.FixedGeneralUi: General UI fixes: resolved an unintended 'F1' hover tooltip on buttons and added an unread release indicator to the Changelog button.
Changelog.v010Alpha.Milestone: First official Alpha release (v0.1.0-alpha): consolidates all prior pre-alpha testing iterations into a cohesive baseline build.
Changelog.v032.UpdatedKnowledgeBase: Updated the built-in Knowledge Base with full coverage of recent features: Edit mode & Radi-oh! import, stream read-ahead buffering (2s–30s), mini-player VU meter & listening stats, customizable global hotkeys, and tray/storage.
Changelog.v031.CustomizableHotkeys: Global hotkeys can now be customized and personalized in Settings → Radio (any Ctrl/Alt/Shift combination with A–Z, 0–9 or Space, live key capture, conflict detection, and reset to defaults).
Changelog.v030.RefactorZeroHardcoding: Refactored codebase for modularity and efficiency: dynamic User-Agent & app identity via AppVersion, shared pooled streaming HttpClient, centralized RadioOptions, idle-safe listening stats timer, and COM teardown on exit.
Changelog.v030.SettingsAlignmentAndColor: Fixed Settings card wrapping and control alignment (uniform 220px dropdowns, flush-right switches) and made the accent color picker clearly visible in a dimmed greyed-out state when following Windows system accent colors.
Changelog.v030.DocumentationReadme: Added a comprehensive README.md covering features, modular architecture, shortcuts, and build instructions.
Changelog.v029.FrameAccuratePlayoutEngin: Upgraded stream playout to a frame-accurate MediaStreamSource queue enforcing exact pre-buffer durations (2s–30s), live buffer telemetry, and stutter-free rebuffer recovery.
Changelog.v028.BufferedStreamEngine: Added a local read-ahead stream buffer proxy with single-connection ICY metadata demuxing, seamless auto-reconnect, and user-configurable buffer duration (2s–30s) in Settings.
Changelog.v027.TrueStickyEditToolbar: Player card now scrolls naturally out of view while keeping only the edit toolbar sticky at the top for long lists.
Changelog.v026.StickyEditToolbar: Made the edit toolbar and player header sticky while scrolling long favorites lists.
Changelog.v025.MovedEditButton: Moved the edit button and edit toolbar directly to the Favorites header for clearer separation from playback tools.
Changelog.v024.AddedBulkSelectionAndDrag: Added item checkboxes, Shift+click range selection, bulk delete, and multi-select drag-and-drop reordering in Edit mode.
Changelog.v023.AddedRadiOhImportAndSmoot: Added Radi-oh! JSON backup import (customName & sorting preserved) with confirmation prompt to append favorites, plus 60fps VU meter smoothing.
Changelog.v022.AddedMiniVuAndControls: Upgraded the mini-player with a full-width transport and volume bar plus a live stereo L/R VU meter.
Changelog.v021.FixedMiniPlayer: Locked the mini-player to a fixed client size (408×186) so the bottom edge is never clipped.
Changelog.v020.RebrandDial: Rebranded to Dial with customizable Radi-oh!-inspired favorites (list/grid toggle, position numbers, alignment, font scale) and inline edit mode.
Changelog.v020.AddedDiscover: Added Discover tab powered by Radio Browser API with A–Z country filter, genre/name search, and live stream preview.
Changelog.v020.AddedTimerStats: Added 6-hour sleep timer, live session counter, persistent per-station listening stats, and .chassispack / DIAL-v1 favorites sharing.
Changelog.v020.AddedMiniHotkeys: Added compact Mini-Player mode (Ctrl+M, Always on Top) and optional global hotkeys.
Changelog.v010.AddedRadio: Added all four KINK live radio stations: KINK, KINK Distortion, KINK 80's, and KINK 90's (192 kbps MP3 with AAC fallback).
Changelog.v010.AddedTray: Added system tray lifecycle with right-click controls and live ICY/SMTC metadata.
